'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Battle of Sievierodonetsk (2022)|Battle of Sievierodonetsk]]
****[[Governor of Luhansk Oblast]] [[Serhiy Haidai]] announces that [[Ukrainian forces]] will withdraw from [[Sievierodonetsk]] amid the advance of Russian and pro-[[Russian forces]]. [https://www.axios.com/2022/06/24/ukrainian-troops-severodonetsk-withdraw (Axios)] 
***A [[Russian occupation of Kherson Oblast|Russian-appointed senior official]] for the Kherson youth department is killed by a [[car bomb]]ing in [[Kherson]] in an apparent [[assassination]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/6/24/russian-appointed-official-killed-blast-ukraine-occupied-kherson (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2022/06/24/car-bomb-kills-russia-installed-official-in-occupied-ukraine-a78094 (''The Moscow Times'')]
***Ukrainian authorities say that Russian forces have captured the city of [[Hirske]], south of [[Lysychansk]], in [[Luhansk Oblast]]. [[Head of the Chechen Republic|Chechen leader]] [[Ramzan Kadyrov]] says that his forces also captured the town of [[Zolote]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-loses-key-district-south-lysychansk-russian-forces-official-2022-06-24/ (Reuters)] [https://www.newsweek.com/chechen-leader-claims-russian-troops-have-seized-zolote-gorskoye-1719025 (''Newsweek'')]
*Two [[Tunisia]]n [[police officer]]s are injured in a [[stabbing]] and suspected [[terrorist attack]] in the [[Grand Synagogue of Tunis]]. [https://apnews.com/article/politics-africa-tunisia-arrests-tunis-6bfddc5f795361089e3bd5c0b070f873 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Melilla incident]]
**Eighteen migrants are killed and hundreds of people injured, mostly Spanish and Moroccan security forces, as around 2,000 migrants attempt to illegally enter [[Melilla]], [[Spain]], from [[Morocco]]. [https://apnews.com/article/africa-migration-spain-north-a52c8af0dc8c96ce37f265f1c41a9714 (AP)]
*Five people are killed and eleven others are injured in [[Gayan District]], [[Paktika Province]], [[Afghanistan]], by an [[aftershock]] from [[June 2022 Afghanistan earthquake|the recent earthquake]] that killed at least 1,100 people in Afghanistan and [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/afghan-authorities-end-search-survivors-earthquake-that-killed-1000-2022-06-24/ (Reuters)]
*An [[Ilyushin Il-76]] [[military aircraft|military]] [[cargo plane]] carrying nine people [[plane crash|crashes]] near [[Ryazan]], [[Russia]], killing five passengers. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/cargo-plane-crash-lands-near-russias-ryazan-seven-injured-ifax-2022-06-24/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Accession of North Macedonia to the European Union]], [[Bulgaria–North Macedonia relations]]
**[[Bulgaria]] lifts its [[veto]] against [[North Macedonia]]'s bid to join the [[European Union]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/bulgaria-lawmakers-agree-to-lift-block-on-north-macedonia-eu-talks/a-62249425 (DW)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Abortion in the United States]]
**''[[Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health Organization]]''
***The [[United States Supreme Court]] overturns ''[[Roe v. Wade]]'' and ''[[Planned Parenthood v. Casey]]'', ending protection of the right to [[abortion]] on the federal level and returning regulation to the [[U.S. state|states]]. Twenty-two states enact trigger laws or reinstitute existing laws banning abortion. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/us-supreme-court-overturns-abortion-rights-landmark-2022-06-24/ (Reuters)] [https://www.cnbc.com/2022/06/24/states-set-to-ban-abortion-after-supreme-court-overturns-roe-v-wade.html (CNBC)]
*[[Kongsberg attack]]
**A court in [[Norway]] finds the attacker not criminally responsible due to [[paranoid schizophrenia]] and sentences him to compulsory mental treatment. [https://www.euronews.com/2022/06/24/norway-bow-and-arrow-and-knife-attack-perpetrator-sentenced-to-compulsory-mental-care (Euronews)]
*[[2021 Cuban protests]]
**A court in [[Cuba]] sentences two protesters to between five and nine years in prison for desecrating the [[Flag of Cuba|Cuban flag]] and resisting authority during [[2021 Cuban protests|last year's protests]]. [https://cnnespanol.cnn.com/2022/06/24/cuba-condena-destacados-artistas-disidentes-trax/ (CNN en Español)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Grenadian general election]]
**The oppositional [[National Democratic Congress (Grenada)|National Democratic Congress]] wins the majority of seats in [[Grenada]]'s latest [[Elections in Grenada|general election]]. NDC's party leader [[Dickon Mitchell]] is expected to become Grenada's next [[List of heads of government of Grenada|Prime Minister]]. [https://caribbean.loopnews.com/content/grenadas-dickon-mitchell-leads-opposition-ndc-election-victory (Loop Caribbean News)] 
*[[UK parliamentary by-elections]]
**The [[Conservative Party (UK)|Conservative Party]] is defeated in both the [[2022 Tiverton and Honiton by-election|Tiverton and Honiton by-election]] and the [[2022 Wakefield by-election|Wakefield by-election]] by the [[Liberal Democrats (UK)|Liberal Democrats]] and the [[Labour Party (UK)|Labour Party]], respectively. Conservative chairman [[Oliver Dowden]] resigns in the aftermath of the defeats. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/uk-politics-61789404 (BBC News)]
